title: TIFF to RGBA pixels
summary: Decode an in-memory 8-bit RGB or RGBA TIFF file (strips, uncompressed, LZW or Deflate, with or without the horizontal predictor) to a width, a height and a buffer of pixel bytes.
notes: Inputs are hex strings, because fixtures are shared as JSON; every adapter turns them into bytes in prepare, before any timing, so the measured call decodes bytes only.
